questions.explain: Vectored yaw provides yaw in hover by tilting the motors.

options: All motors tilt except the tail one
questions.explain: Bit 0 is motor 1, bit 1 is motor 2.

questions.q: Why can a motor spin up with no command during a channel check?
options: The motor and servo outputs are swapped
Too high a P gain in the yaw rate loop
questions.explain: A motor function is assigned to an output physically wired to a servo, and the other way around. The output map is built by hand with the props off.

questions.q: Why can't you mix a DShot motor and a 50 Hz servo on one timer?
options: You can, there are no limits
You can, if the servo and the motor share a BEC
questions.explain: Within a timer group all outputs share one protocol and rate.

questions.q: What do you check on the ground before the first flight of a tilt-rotor?
options: Only that the aircraft arms in QHOVER
questions.explain: Smooth tilt, servo trims, directions: in MANUAL the motors point forward, in QSTABILIZE up.

questions.q: What are the function numbers of TiltMotorFrontLeft / FrontRight?
questions.explain: 75 and 76 are for vectored yaw; 41 is the common front tilt.

options: The speed below which the VTOL motors assist
The speed at which the VTOL → fixed-wing transition completes

questions.explain: Otherwise it stalls after the transition.
